engines.label: jaren (@jarenjs/db)
engines.adapter: node:sqlite file db (WAL), entities with FK+age indexes; validation OFF except the validated row

engines.label: Drizzle
engines.adapter: drizzle-orm over better-sqlite3 (WAL), prepared statements, relational query builder for the graph

engines.label: Kysely
engines.adapter: kysely SqliteDialect over better-sqlite3 (WAL); a typed SQL builder — the graph row is hand-written json_group_array

engines.label: Prisma
engines.adapter: @prisma/client (generated, engine warmed by $connect) over its SQLite connector (WAL); profile is TEXT — no Json type on SQLite

engines.label: jaren client (@jarenjs/linq/db)
engines.adapter: the typed client over the same node:sqlite store (WAL); every read a chain or an include graph; validation OFF except the validated row

notes: graph-load headline: jaren answers the two-level graph in one statement, 7.1x faster than Prisma on this corpus
bunNotes: Bun capability cliff: Kysely's better-sqlite3 dialect and Prisma's engine have no first-party bun:sqlite route, so their rows are Node-only; on Bun there is also no UDF hatch and no session capture (bun:sqlite has no function/aggregate/createSession).
cold start is measured on the Node run (spawned node processes).
graph-load headline: jaren answers the two-level graph in one statement, 2.5x faster than Drizzle on this corpus
